I am old now, 76 years, and my back does not carry me like before. This small piece of land I rent, I plant my yams and cassava the way my mother taught me — I cannot waste money on the chemical fertilizer when the price is high and I am not even sure of the harvest on land that is not mine. I will use the small manure from my goats and the household, and my own seed pieces from last season. My grandchildren will help me with the heavy work, but my hands cannot do everything, so I will pay one or two young men for the clearing and the mounding.
